thread:
lina: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: pricing/packaging/usage policies. Drop short clarifying Qs and we'll route.
sam: Clarify credits lifecycle: do trial or promo credits ever roll month-to-month or auto-extend?
julia: Default policy: credits expire 12 months from issuance unless a promo explicitly states differently. Non-transferable, non-refundable. We'll add exact language to billing TOS + FAQ.
lina: Thanks @julia. @sam can you add a docs task to update the public FAQ?
sam: Will do.
maya: Rate limits question: is there a hard per-minute burst cap separate from per-second limits? Customers want deterministic numbers.
ethan: Hosted defaults are soft ~10 rps (≈600 rpm) per project. We have a short queue grace (default 60s) before returning 429s. Responses include headers: `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset`.
ops-bot: rollout-note: rate-limit headers in canary for eu-west-1.
tim: Sales note: Dedicated contracts can include a prepaid burst pool as an add-on. Billing treats burst pool consumption separately from committed units (prepaid minutes/GPU-hours).
maya: Are bursts metered differently vs committed capacity? Is there a default price model or is it negotiated?
julia: Burst pools are typically prepaid at a rate tied to GPU family and region; pricing is negotiated for enterprise deals. We'll publish a sample rate card for sales decks.
ethan: SDKs will surface the rate-limit headers and provide a backoff helper this sprint. Also experimenting with an opt-in `X-Queue-ETA-ms` header in canary for queued requests.
devex: I'll draft a 1-page "When you hit limits" playbook for CSM/Sales: includes cURL snippets parsing headers, suggested backoff, and decision tree (Optimize, Dedicated, burst pool). Draft by Friday.
sam: One more: can credits apply to Marketplace add-ons or seat/invoice charges?
julia: Default: credits apply to API usage only. Marketplace or third-party charges are billed separately unless a promo explicitly states otherwise. We'll list exceptions in the FAQ.
lina: Action items recap: 1) @sam update billing FAQ about credit expiry & marketplace scope; 2) @devex publish one-pager with examples; 3) eng/runtime to evaluate per-org throttle-grace config (ticket ORG-981). I'll compile the follow-up doc and post a link in #docs. Add anything else here and tag me. Thanks all!
